definitions.explanation: A large white-fleshed fish of cold northern seas, at its best in winter. In Japan it is eaten above all in hot pots, and its roe is the popular たらこ.

examples.japanese: タラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}まった→温まる：02095_atatamaru⟧。
examples.english: The cod hot pot warmed me up.

examples.japanese: タラ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{白|しろ}くて→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかく→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Cod has soft white flesh and is often used in winter hot-pot dishes.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spelling is {鱈|たら}, with the ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧ (snow) component of a winter fish.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タラちり: a hot pot of cod and vegetables
- ⟦たらこ→たらこ：15258_tarako⟧: salted cod (strictly pollock) roe; ⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧ is the spicy kind
- タラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白子|しらこ}→白子：21830_shirako⟧: cod milt, a winter delicacy

WATCH OUT:
In speech the fish is easily heard as the conditional 〜たら ("if"); context always decides.
